exposure: maternal non-biologic systemic treatment during pregnancy
cohort: The study included 1027 children born to women with rheumatic/inflammatory diseases treated with anti-TNF, 9346 children to women with non-biologic systemic treatment, and 1,617,886 children from the general population.
finding: Both maternal anti-TNF and non-biologic systemic treatment during pregnancy were associated with an increased risk of paediatric infections, primarily in the first year of life, with these risks not persisting throughout the first three years or varying with third-trimester treatment or combination therapy.
